def predict_loo(ct_data, temperature, base_up_pow, slope_up_pow, down_pow, 
                ratio_clip_max, up_shrink, down_shrink, use_target_quantile=False,
                base_down_pow=None, slope_down_pow=None):
    ctrl_means_np = ct_data['ctrl_means']
    stim_diffs_np = ct_data['stim_diffs']
    target_ctrl_mean = ct_data['target_ctrl_mean']

        c = np.corrcoef(target_ctrl_mean, ctrl_means_np[i])[0, 1]
        corrs[i] = c if np.isfinite(c) else -1.0

    logits = corrs / temperature
    logits -= logits.max()
    weights = np.exp(logits)
    weights /= weights.sum()

    ref_ctrl = (weights.reshape(-1, 1) * ctrl_means_np).sum(axis=0)
    ref_diff = (weights.reshape(-1, 1) * stim_diffs_np).sum(axis=0)

    w_ratio = np.where(w_mean_abs > 1e-10, wstd / np.maximum(w_mean_abs, 1e-10), 0)

    shrink[down_mask_diff] = 1.0 / (1.0 + down_shrink * w_ratio[down_mask_diff])

    pred_mean_scaled = np.clip(pred_mean_scaled, 0, 1)
